combined_with_step1.description: Total of the original 119 missed_detection group now confirmed genuinely persistent (free-fix rescues + long-window verifies).

step3_full_sweep_rescreen_and_fnr_estima.description: Full sweep-wide re-screen using the settled-only free fix (step 1's rule applied to ALL node-checks in the original 2400 sweep, not just the 119 missed_detection group), followed by a randomly sampled false-negative-rate estimate on the two disjoint populations this produces.

population_A_screened_out.description: Node-checks still screened out even after the free fix.

population_B_newly_promoted.description: Node-checks with settled=True but NOT sustained_and_settled=True (i.e. rescued candidates from the free fix, sweep-wide) that have not yet been long-window verified.

corrected_density_estimate.formula: corrected_TP = known_TP + rate_B * n_newly_promoted_total + rate_A * n_screened_out_total
